source.title: M0.0B — Full ShinaCare Core Coverage Matrix & Missing-Feature Closure
source.body:
## Feature coverage crosscheck (13 Nov)

Map C/O/X journeys and open decisions in [Persona E2E Scenario Matrix](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/document/shinacare-v1-persona-e2e-scenario-matrix-routine-cod-doorstep-7e8df14cc3da>) to current code, acceptance, evidence and missing functionality. Proposed defaults are not owner-approved scope yet.

## PHASE 1 PROCUREMENT RULE — 13 NOV OWNER DECISION

No supplier login, supplier response, RFQ, broadcast, POs or APIs are first-release active requirements. All purchasing is performed manually **outside the system**, but Hub/Admin require an accurate internal aggregated **Buy List** over actual outstanding order items, plus manual acquired/shortage tracking before Hub dispatch. Preserve existing supplier/purchasing code inactive; never use a fake supplier identity or turn Stage 2/3 into this MVP. Use [GLO-296](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-296>) as the core owner. This newer decision overrides older references to 'Hub manual tenders' and source-neutral supplier portal as an operational launch requirement. Catalogue ingestion remains source-neutral independent of supplier authentication.

## New full-core requirement (13 Nov): WHY I BOUGHT IT [GLO-314](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-314>)

This is a **purchase-intent memory per OrderItem**, available after direct PDP/search/concern, chatbot or routine purchase — NOT a "why this product" marketing explanation, and NOT only within My Routine. User-selected/confirmed purpose is optional, editable with ownership checks; silent inference is prohibited. Add row to Full MVP Inventory as CORE-LOCKED but unverified until code/tests prove it.

## 13 Nov OWNER DECISION: ROUTINES CORE-LOCKED

The previous 'Routine Builder / My Routine / Ready Routines — scope decision needed' is RESOLVED: all **three** are mandatory in first ShinaCare release. Map [GLO-311](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-311>) manual builder/shared engine, [GLO-312](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-312>) Admin Ready Routine Studio and [GLO-313](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-313>) AI routine proposal & user confirmation to real routes/contracts/tests. Their existence is NOT yet verified. Four editorial starter templates are targets contingent on real product evidence; pregnancy-specific template not auto-approved.

## SOURCE OF TRUTH / AUDIT WORKBOOK — 13 NOV

Use the new [ShinaCare v1 Full MVP Feature Inventory & Gap Audit](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/document/shinacare-v1-full-mvp-feature-inventory-and-gap-audit-source-of-truth-455df701078c>) as the row-level acceptance inventory. It consolidates approved requirements, separates CORE-LOCKED from DECISION-NEEDED and future updates, and marks every current code status NOT-CHECKED until tested. First deliverable is to turn each NOT-CHECKED into evidenced VERIFIED/PARTIAL/MISSING/BLOCKED and return the finite missing-feature register. Do **not** assert the audit has been performed simply because the document exists. Reconcile Care Profile, My Routine/Builder, Reviews and Comparison explicitly with latest owner decision. Chatbot + Recommendation Engine are mandatory.

# Mandatory scope-closure gate (13 Nov owner decision)

**Question to answer with evidence:** Have we covered the **whole agreed ShinaCare first-release core**, not merely completed a to-do list? This task is for current-HEAD discovery and traceability first, not a new feature brainstorm. It complements [GLO-308](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-308>) (launch blockers) by covering **feature completeness**.

## Inventory + traceability matrix

Examine actual code, routes, APIs, data and current product decisions; for EACH feature record:

* capability, customer/ops use case and entry point;
* **mandatory core / explicitly deferred / owner decision needed** — do not default 'missing' to 'deferred';
* actual state **verified working / partial / absent / blocked / unknown**;
* source data/API + relevant Linear issue; screenshot or DB/HTTP/browser/test evidence;
* missing acceptance cases, dependencies, blocking risk and smallest completion task.

**At minimum audit**:

1. Catalog/Admin+Supplier source-neutral ingest: matching, researched facts/evidence, images, brand/line knowledge, approval/publication/sellability.
2. Homepage paths: Shop by Concern/Category, brand/line, PLP/PDP/variants, related products, filters, Arabic+English search.
3. Customer auth/account, guest cart, checkout/COD, map pin, address, tracking, orders, support, returns/refunds.
4. Admin/Hub/Delivery, manual supplier sourcing, procurement fallback, receiving/scan/pack, COD, settings/finance/access.
5. **Mandatory** AI Chatbot + OpenRouter and **mandatory** Recommendation Engine, care/profile context and live catalog retrieval, real output on relevant screens, action confirmation and failure fallback.
6. Previously discussed product comparison, verified buyer reviews, ready routines/Routine Builder/Care Profile: explicitly check existing code & latest owner decision. **Do not silently hide or pretend these are complete**; surface ambiguous former postponements for owner scope resolution.
7. UI/UX quality across Storefront and Business, responsive/RTL/accessibility, design/content consistency.
8. Security, real integration/negative tests, external providers/credentials, deployment staging/backup/rollback, docs.

## Acceptance

Produce a *single* finite evidence-based coverage matrix linked to existing release issues AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#178..309 and an ordered gap/decision log. For missing **approved mandatory core**, create/attach precise remediation under this batch only if not already captured; avoid duplicate tickets. Mark nothing verified solely from issue status or screenshots. AI Chatbot + Recommendations cannot be 'optional' in this project. Confirm whether previously postponed Routine Builder is in first release; this remains **explicit owner scope decision**, not a silent exclusion.
**Done:** every user-visible entry point and operational role has a known disposition and test strategy; unclear scope is highlighted, not guessed. This audit alone does NOT mark actual features Done.
